يتداخلا (form VI)
# يَتَدَاخَلَا (yatadāḵalā) /ja.ta.daː.xa.laː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَدَاخَلَ (tadāḵala)
# يُتَدَاخَلَا (yutadāḵalā) /ju.ta.daː.xa.laː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَدَاخَلَ (tadāḵala)
